title: PPS proposals released October 5, 2026
coverage: All named actions in the release memo and district/regional summaries; district and four regional comparison tables; twelve official boundary maps. Proposal release, not a board decision or complete assignment model.
limitations: Proposals for review, not adopted assignments. The October 6 presentation requested no decision; no later meeting outcome is asserted.
School-level actuals and baseline forecasts stay in the explorer and are not A/B projections.
A school absent from these action records is not necessarily unaffected. The reviewed text may omit map-only details.
School/program/site identities and overlapping change categories remain separate.
Official PDF maps do not provide an address-level assignment service.

issues.title: School-level scenario forecasts are not published in this packet
issues.detail: The reviewed packet does not include a complete compatible school-level A/B enrollment, capacity-utilization, or savings table. Existing explorer forecasts describe their own published baseline, not these scenarios.
issues.treatment: No receiving-school enrollment estimates, inferred transfer volumes, or new scenario utilization figures are displayed.

issues.title: Change categories overlap
issues.detail: A school can have a consolidation, program move, grade change and boundary change. A receiver is not another closure. MLC grades 9–12 is explicitly excluded from school closure counts.
issues.treatment: Display each published category independently; never sum categories into a unique affected-school or student total.

issues.title: A shared boundary-change name does not establish identical boundaries
issues.detail: The summary lists schools with boundary changes but does not encode proposed polygons or address-level assignment rules. A/B both listing a school is insufficient to classify its boundary as equal.
issues.treatment: List every named school, mark boundary detail unresolved, and provide the appropriate official maps.

issues.title: Student-transition denominator is not established
issues.detail: The district summary says students who would change schools. Its second page and board deck page 44 specify K–8, with 7,981 / 27% in A and 6,988 / 24% in B. The exact denominator and base-year assumptions are not established by these labels.
issues.treatment: Retain the K–8 scope and both citations; do not back-calculate a denominator from rounded percentages.

issues.title: Board-deck school/program totals need clarification
issues.detail: Page 20 pairs a Scenario A table totaling 68 schools/programs with a Scenario B caption of 65 even though B closes fewer schools. The definitions or counts need reconciliation.
issues.treatment: Exclude the remaining-school/program total from headline charts; retain the source question here.

issues.title: Map year and projection year differ
issues.detail: All twelve official maps, including Status Quo, are labeled 2027–28. District and regional comparison metrics are labeled projections for 2031–32 unless noted.
issues.treatment: Keep the two years visible and separate. Status Quo maps are not asserted to be current-year boundaries.

issues.title: Receiving-school transition details remain to be developed
issues.detail: The release memo states that receiving-school readiness, transportation, staffing and transition supports require further implementation planning.
issues.treatment: A published destination does not establish readiness, travel time, staffing changes or an individual student assignment.

issues.title: Brentwood explorer identity needs explicit confirmation
issues.detail: The proposal names Brentwood MS; the existing enrollment directory includes Lane. This release does not assume that a rename establishes a matched publication identity.
issues.treatment: Brentwood remains searchable with proposal actions and sources, but has no school-profile link.

issues.title: Program discontinuation has more than one source treatment
issues.detail: The memo’s one program discontinuation refers to Sunnyside’s environmental focus option. The summary separately describes MLC grades 9–12 ending, explicitly outside the school-closure count.
issues.treatment: Show both program-ending actions; do not publish a synthesized program-closure total.

issues.title: Bridger middle-grade destination needs clarification
issues.detail: District summary page 2 names Harrison Park. Press release page 4 says designated neighborhood middle schools. The release does not establish whether that broader wording includes additional destinations.
issues.treatment: Show both statements together. Do not treat Harrison Park as a fully resolved individual assignment.

issues.title: MLC high-school destination wording differs
issues.detail: District summary page 2 says neighborhood high school. Press release page 4 says an appropriate educational option. Neither is a reviewed individual placement.
issues.treatment: Retain the program ending while marking destination detail unresolved.
